input.quote: 14.1 Term. The term of this Agreement (the "Term") will commence on the Effective Date and will expire upon the earliest of (i) termination of this Agreement in accordance with Section 14.2, or (ii) the date of payment of the last Approval Payment due based on all applicable Regulatory Approvals which have been received.
input.rationale: Section 14.1 sets a single fixed Term running from the Effective Date until the earlier of termination under Section 14.2 or payment of the final Approval Payment. A full-text search for "renew"/"automatically renew"/"Renewal Term" returns no auto-renewal, evergreen extension, non-renewal notice window or renewal price-uplift mechanic anywhere in the Agreement (the only "renewal" hits relate to IP registrations, Permitted Liens refinancing and insurance coverage). There is therefore no renewal to exit and no notice window to compute; any extension of this development-funding arrangement would require mutual written agreement, which matches the playbook's preferred position. No walk-away features (multi-year auto-renewals or >90-day non-renewal notice) are present. PB also retains at-will termination (§ 14.2.2) and other termination rights, so exit is not constrained by a renewal mechanic. No redline needed.
